strengths: The multigenerational hero immediately expresses the lifelong-Rattler premise.
The Lifer is a memorable original character and gives the campaign a reusable visual narrator.
Expressive type, scale pattern, paper grain, wool, leather, concrete, and layered surfaces solve the prior flatness problem.
The evidence section turns fan pride into a sourced argument rather than an unsupported claim.
The desktop and mobile compositions retain hierarchy without horizontal overflow.
known_limits: This is a self-review, not an independent visual approval.
The suggested handle has not been checked or registered on every platform.
The roll call is a local prototype and intentionally transmits no data.
No official FAMU brand approval has been requested; the concept remains clearly unofficial.
No social account or post has been published.
